model_organism.citation: Ueno et al. 2011 - KIF16B/Rab14 molecular motor complex is critical for early embryonic development by transporting FGF receptor (PMID: 21238925)
model_organism.knockout_type: other: dominant-negative Rab14 (Rab14-GDP) overexpression in mouse embryos. The Kif16b full knockout, a Rab14 effector/motor, was studied in parallel, and Rab14 itself was not knocked out.
phenotypes: Rab14-GDP dominant-negative overexpression reproduced the Kif16b/FGFR2 deficiency phenotype
Defective basement membrane assembly by the primitive endoderm lineage
In the parallel Kif16b-/- knockout, embryos failed to develop epiblast and primitive endoderm lineages and died at peri-implantation, similar to FGFR2 knockout embryos

biological.summary: Rab14 knockdown produced elongated mitochondria and increased mitochondrial proteins, whereas overexpression increased mitophagy in mito-Keima assays. Rab14-induced mitophagy depends on Parkin, TBK1 and PI3K activity, placing it in the Parkin-dependent mitophagy pathway. TGN-derived Rab14 vesicles form contact sites with mitochondria that require PI(4)KIIIβ.

biological.citation: The endocytic pathway taken by cationic substances requires Rab14 but not Rab5 and Rab7 (PMID: 34731620)
biological.summary: Cell-penetrating peptides, polyamines and homeodomains use an endocytic route to nonacidic Lamp1-positive late endosomes. This route is independent of Rab5 and Rab7 but requires Rab14.

biological.citation: RAB14 GTPase is essential for actin-based asymmetric division during mouse oocyte maturation (PMID: 34323331)
biological.summary: In mouse oocytes, RAB14 localizes to the cortex and spindle periphery. siRNA depletion caused spindle migration defects, large polar bodies (failed asymmetric division) and aberrant Golgi distribution, acting through the ROCK-cofilin pathway. Myc-Rab14 mRNA rescued these defects.

biological.citation: Biogenesis of Rab14-positive endosome buds at Golgi-endosome contacts by the RhoBTB3-SHIP164-Vps26B complex (PMID: 38565878)
biological.summary: Vps26B is a novel Rab14 effector, and Rab14 activity regulates SHIP164 association with early endosomes. SHIP164 depletion leads to enlarged Rab14+ endosomes lacking buds, so the RhoBTB3-SHIP164-Vps26B complex drives Rab14+ endosome budding at Golgi-endosome contacts.

biological.citation: Rab14/MACF2 complex regulates endosomal targeting during cytokinesis (PMID: 33566684)
biological.summary: Rab14 depletion or knockout causes cytokinesis failure or prolonged division, impairs Rab11-endosome recruitment to intracellular bridge microtubules and blocks actin clearance at the abscission site. Rab14 binds the MACF2/CAMSAP3 complex, which affects endosome targeting.

biological.citation: Microscopic and biochemical monitoring of endosomal trafficking and extracellular vesicle secretion in an endogenous in vivo model (PMID: 36103151)
biological.summary: In a Drosophila fat body RNAi model, Rab14 together with the kinesin Klp98A was found to function in extracellular vesicle biogenesis and secretion. Rab11 and Rab35 were the main regulators of EV secretion.

biological.citation: Isolation, sequence identification and tissue expression distribution of three novel porcine genes--RAB14, S35A3 and ITM2A (PMID: 17380425)
biological.summary: Porcine RAB14 encodes a 215-aa protein with 99% identity to human and mouse and 100% to rat. It is highly expressed in fat, lung, spleen and kidney, moderately in large intestine, weakly in small intestine, and barely in muscle and liver.

biological.citation: A genome-wide CRISPR screen defines host determinants of early Brucella infection in human macrophage-like cells (PMID: 42402044)
biological.summary: A genome-wide CRISPR screen in human macrophage-like cells found that RAB14 supports B. abortus and B. ovis infection at a post-entry step. RAB14 was dispensable for Mycobacterium abscessus infection, indicating a pathogen-specific dependency.

biological.citation: Rab14 restricts pathogens by promoting V-ATPase lysosomal delivery to drive lysosomal acidification (PMID: 41771894)
biological.summary: Rab14 is a broad-spectrum restriction factor against bacteria and viruses. Infection raises GTP-bound Rab14, which binds CAMK2D and blocks its phosphorylation of V0a1. This promotes V0a1-COPII binding and ER-to-lysosome V-ATPase trafficking, leading to lysosomal acidification and pathogen clearance (Rab14-CAMK2D-V-ATPase axis).

biological.citation: Targeting CPT1A-mediated fatty acid oxidation sensitizes nasopharyngeal carcinoma to radiation therapy (PMID: 29721083)
biological.summary: Mass spectrometry identified Rab14 as a CPT1A-binding protein, confirmed by immunoprecipitation, immunofluorescence and proximity ligation assay. The interaction promotes fatty acid trafficking from lipid droplets to mitochondria, and Rab14 knockdown attenuated this trafficking and radiation resistance in NPC cells.
